name: mimo-code
label: MiMo Code
description: Xiaomi's terminal coding agent for MiMo models, driven headless
tagline: Xiaomi's terminal coding agent, on a MiMo API key or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Installed by Xiaomi's own script.

check_ready.not_ready_message: Not configured — set an API key and a model (press e). A MiMo API key works with the prefilled base URL; create one at https://platform.xiaomimimo.com.

env_config.name: LLM_API_KEY
env_config.description: API key — a MiMo API key from https://platform.xiaomimimo.com, a MiMo Token Plan key (with its Token Plan base URL), or a key for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint set below.

env_config.name: LLM_BASE_URL
env_config.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, prefilled with MiMo's API. MiMo Token Plan: https://token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com/v1 (Europe: token-plan-ams, Singapore: token-plan-sgp). Any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint works too.

env_config.name: LLM_MODEL
env_config.description: Model id, e.g. mimo-v2.5-pro. Pick one the base URL serves; the list is loaded from it.
